caption: The drawing features a centrally placed oval frame with multiple concentric borders in shades of brown, beige, and gold. Inside the oval, there is a wreath composed of various flowers and green leaves, arranged in a circular formation. The flowers are predominantly white with some touches of pink, blue, yellow, and red, and include detailed petals and centers, with green leaves interspersed throughout. The background inside the oval is filled with a solid brown color, creating a contrast with the lighter colors of the flowers and the leaves. The outer area beyond the oval frame is an off-white or light beige, mostly unadorned except for a signature “Marius N. Hansen” in blue ink at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Feather Wreath
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
